limitations: The novelty claim is now restricted to alpha=0. Positive alpha is prior coverage in Castillo--Sadigova v2. No classification is claimed for asymmetric Jacobi parameters and no quantitative interior gap is optimized. Originality is to the best of current indexed literature.
provenance: Repaired after Castillo--Sadigova arXiv:2609.15473v2 (25 Sep 2026) added Proposition 6.3 covering the complete minimizer classification for alpha>0. The surviving contribution is restricted to the Legendre endpoint alpha=0: complete minimizer multiplicities and uniqueness of the 1,2,5 anomaly at x=-1/3.
record_title: Complete Legendre minimizer classification for the ultraspherical lower envelope
